Structured softness. A bag defined by what it leaves out — no hardware, no branding, no noise.

02 / Product

Rectangular form. Dual handles. One pocket.

The geometry is deliberate: a rectangle you can fill, handles you can grab, and a quilted front pocket that defines the face without demanding attention. Off-white canvas — the color of a blank page before you start writing.

05 / Composition

Material

100% cotton canvas. Diamond quilt stitch pattern. No synthetic lining. No plastic hardware. Softens with age.

Maintenance

Spot clean only. Cold water, mild soap. Air dry in shade. Do not machine wash, bleach, or iron on high heat.

Dimensions

Generous capacity. Fits up to 15-inch laptop, daily necessities, and an extra layer. See size guide for exact measurements.
